title: KalshiStakeAuthorityEnvelope
description: The deterministic authority envelope for the Kalshi stake path, held outside the model: venue, admitted series, per-order and cumulative caps, drawdown floor, expiry, kill path, and signer, armed false by default. The founder is named as principal by actor id only, never by credential.

admittedSeries.description: Kalshi series tickers this envelope admits (e.g. KXHIGHNY). A market whose series is not in this list is refused regardless of every other bound.

perOrderCapUsd.description: Exact decimal string: the maximum USD stake any single order may place.

cumulativeCapUsd.description: Exact decimal string: the maximum total USD stake this envelope may place across its whole armed lifetime.

drawdownFloorFraction.description: Fraction of the sleeve's riskCapital that, lost cumulatively (a fall from the sleeve equity high-water mark), trips the circuit breaker.

sleeve.description: The bounded-stake sleeve, in the position-sizing-service sleeve shape (@red-cup-engineering/position-sizing-service 0.3.1): riskCapital is walled, losable-to-zero, re-seedable capital; survivalCapital is never risked.

expiry.description: ISO 8601 instant after which this envelope refuses every stake regardless of every other bound, until re-armed with a new expiry.

killPath.description: Names the automatic circuit breaker that unarms this envelope (halt-stake-envelope.mjs, run by a timer) -- never a request for permission.

host.description: The machine holding the Kalshi signing credential (KALSHI_API_KEY_ID / KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH), independent of the model.

actorId.description: The founder named by actor id (house convention: "emsenn"), never by credential or key material.

armed.description: False by default and after any halt. True only after the founder's one arming act (KYC complete, credentials placed on the signer host, this field set true).
